name: Source Data Verification
description: Field- and form-level Source Data Verification (SDV) for clinical trials. Monitors mark which fields require SDV, tick fields as verified, raise and resolve monitor queries with sites, and mark forms as SDV complete. State is held in dedicated indexed tables, independent of the Data Resolution Workflow.

authors.name: Mintoo Xavier
authors.institution: Cambridge University Hospital - Cambridge Cancer Trials Centre

project-settings.name: Monitor role(s). Monitors mark fields as requiring SDV, verify fields, raise queries and mark forms SDV complete
Data entry role(s). Data entry users respond to monitor queries
Data manager role(s). Data managers can view SDV status and queries
Regex matching the action tags of fields that require SDV, e.g. @SDV or @ENDPOINT-[A-Z]+. Do NOT include the surrounding /. Defaults to @SDV when blank
Action tag that excludes a field from SDV entirely, e.g. @SDV-IGNORE
Monitors can only verify and query fields that require SDV
A form marked 'SDV complete' is set back to 'Re-verification required' when its data changes and

choices.name: the changed field had been verified (recommended)
any field on the form changed
the changed field has been queried before
